text:
Hey! First well done for making the effort. I’ve met people here for decades and not speak fluently for whatever reason. 

I like to do 30 minute Hebrew conversations a day with my partner. 

Watching kids shows in Hebrew helped. Sesame Street for instance💛

And main one, keep speaking in Hebrew when people switch to English!!! Bring all the vocab you’ve got and insist on using it. People here like to flex their English, but insist! 

Finding a hobby or volunteer in Hebrew. Hope you get some useful suggestions. Good luck 💛♥️
